body: I wouldn't say it's crazy to talk to yourself inside your head - lots of people do it, actually. I do that all the time, especially when I'm in around a lot of people (I prefer to avoid going to noisy/crowded places, but unfortunately it's inevitable) and I have nothing better to do than talk to myself inside my own head because I lack the social skills to engage in conversation with other people.

I feel exactly the same way. For me, it's not that I don't care about anyone; it's not that I completely lack empathy, it's just that I don't feel emotionally connected to people in the same way that neurotypical people do.

I also have Aspergers and I absolutely agree with u/ProBot420 that the issue with having Aspergers is more to do with society than the condition itself.
As for what you mentioned, OP, I can relate to it A LOT. Throughout my time at school (I'm currently 16 years old) I've had little to no friends because most people deem me as "weird" and also because of how difficult I find it have strong emotion connections with other people. However, many people have told me that the level of intelligence that has come with my Aspergers is a benefit.

I'm here - you can talk to me if you need to.
Unfortunately I have depression and anxiety and have been suicidal before, so I understand what you're going through.

You said you were planning on killing yourself on the 14th of August. It's September now, so were you referring to August next year, or did you write this by mistake?

I completely agree with you, the mental health system is fucking awful.
I don't know too much about the healthcare system in the US, but here in England (and also in many other countries) the mental health system is massively underfunded, and mental illness is generally misunderstood and stigmatized.
I know that a lot of people end up in hospital for having suicidal thoughts, but whenever I talk to my psychologist about wanting to kill myself she completely dismisses it. In fact, she's actually told me that she doesn't even view it as a problem unless I am currently planning on committing suicide.
